Hello! Welcome to Hongkong Post online enquiry. Please enter the corresponding number for the language you select:
你好！欢迎使用香港邮政在线查询服务。请输入相应的数字选择语言：

1. 繁體中文 / Traditional Chinese
2. 英文 / English
3. 简体中文 / Simplified Chinese

Please enter the corresponding number for the information you are looking for (number 1-6):

1. Postage and Preparations before Posting (i.e.: Details of Prohibited Item)
2. Sending Mail
3. Mail Tracing and Compensation
4. Receiving Mail
5. Advance Order Service
6. ShopThruPost

⭐輸入 # 選擇語言 / Type in # to select language

1. Mail Tracing
2. Compensation
